project_type: Next.js 15 App Router with tRPC, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui
build_system: npm with Next.js build. Node available at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin/node. Must export PATH before running npm commands.
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to verify no TS/compilation errors. 2. Run npm run lint (biome check) if time permits.
environment_constraints: Node.js v22 available at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin. npm not on default PATH - must prepend. node_modules already installed. No Docker daemon. All data is mock (no real DB). Biome for linting (not eslint).
contribution_requirements: Continue on feat/ldo2-edms-v3-full-implementation branch. Use mock data (no real DB). Follow design.md style (orange #d38738 primary, dense 38px rows, 30px buttons, 12-13px body text). Update graphify.json after each feature.
key_patterns: tRPC routers in src/server/routers/ with adminProcedure/supervisorProcedure/engineerProcedure/protectedProcedure. Mock data in src/lib/mock-data/. Zustand stores in src/stores/. shadcn/ui components in src/components/ui/. Page components use PageFrame and PageHeader. UserRole hierarchy: admin > supervisor > reviewer > engineer > viewer. Permission check via isRoleAtLeast() in src/lib/auth/permissions.ts.
directory_structure: src/app/(protected)/admin/ - admin pages. src/server/routers/ - tRPC API. src/lib/mock-data/ - mock data stores. src/stores/ - zustand stores. src/components/ - reusable components. src/lib/validators/ - zod schemas.
